meta.description: Assigns honest lipid annotation levels, designs class-based internal-standard quantification, and runs lipid-aware differential and enrichment analysis with lipidr, guarding against in-source-fragment phantoms, sn-position over-claims, and invalid cross-class quantification.
meta.notes: N=9: the 7 pre-fix inputs re-run as regression tests (2 updated to exercise the new istd-coverage guard), plus 2 new inputs (shipped-example-on-real-data, sphingoid ';O#' conversion) per the re-audit dispatch.

scientific_integrity.detail: References unchanged and still cite real, verifiable literature (Liebisch 2013/2020, Kopczynski 2020, Kofeler 2021 x2, Takeda 2024, Mohamed 2020); no fabricated DOI/PMID, trial results, or statistics anywhere in the 9 outputs.

practice_boundaries.detail: Input 7's refusal is now grounded in SKILL.md's new explicit Practice Boundaries section (verified present in the fork: research/analytical use only, not clinical diagnosis, redirect to a qualified clinician), closing the pre-fix gap where the correct refusal relied only on general model judgment.

methodological_ground.detail: Input 6 still correctly declines to validate an untargeted oxidized-lipid claim as publication-ready; no correlation/causation or statistical-model fallacy observed in any of the 9 outputs.

code_usability.detail: R (lipidr) code in Inputs 1, 5, 8 and Python (pygoslin) code in Inputs 2, 9 all ran end-to-end without modification, including two full lipidr pipelines against real (not synthetic) bundled data. The pre-fix pygoslin RuntimeException (4/7 names) and normalize_istd silent-no-op are both confirmed fixed by direct re-execution.

functional_suitability.note: Pre-fix gap closed: the Goslin honest-downgrade pattern now shows the level-capping guard handling names parsed at or below MOLECULAR_SPECIES (sum-composition, ether, plasmalogen), verified 0/7 crashes on re-run.

reliability.note: Both pre-fix gaps closed: the pygoslin level-exceeds-claimed exception is now caught by a level cap, and a class lacking an internal standard now raises a named stop(). One point held back: the istd-coverage guard is table()-based and silently misses lipids with Class=NA entirely (not just uncovered classes) -- reproduced on lipidr's own real bundled data (Input 8).

performance_context.note: SKILL.md grew from ~190 to 249 lines to add the Practice Boundaries section and two guard code blocks, still linear with no redundant steps; usage-guide.md and examples/lipidomics_workflow.R remain separate reference files.

agent_usability.note: The per-class internal-standard coverage check that was 'left implicit' pre-fix is now an explicit, verbatim code block in SKILL.md's Class-Based Internal-Standard section. One point held back for the same NA-class blind spot noted under Reliability.

human_usability.note: Unchanged from pre-fix: natural researcher trigger phrases, explicit Prerequisites section.

security.note: Unchanged: no secrets, no unsafe execution; input validation delegated to lipidr/pygoslin, standard for a Direct-mode instructional skill.

maintainability.note: Unchanged: clean SKILL.md / usage-guide.md / examples/ split; Version Compatibility section documents the re-verification path.

agent_specific.note: Unchanged at max: precise trigger language, 5 cross-referenced adjacent Skills, idempotent, explicit escape hatches -- now reinforced by the new Practice Boundaries section.

recommendations.title: istd-coverage guard is table()-based and silently misses Class=NA rows entirely
recommendations.problem: The guard (table(rowData(d)$Class, rowData(d)$istd)) correctly catches every UNCOVERED CLASS, but R's table() drops NA values by default, so a lipid that failed to parse into any Class at all never appears as a row and is invisible to the check -- it reaches normalize_istd() completely unflagged. Reproduced on lipidr's own real bundled data (1/279 rows, rowname "82").
recommendations.root_cause: The guard's coverage check operates on table(Class, istd), which silently excludes NA-valued groups; the fix closed the per-class gap but not the per-row (unclassified-lipid) gap in the same mechanism.
recommendations.fix: Add an explicit pre-check before the table(): if (any(is.na(rowData(d)$Class))) stop()/warn() naming the unclassified rownames, or filter them out with a clear message before the coverage table is built.

recommendations.title: lipidr's importer still cannot natively parse the ';O2' notation without the manual conversion step
recommendations.problem: The fix adds a working, verified conversion snippet, but it is a manual pre-processing step the agent must remember to apply every time; there is no guard that detects an un-converted ';O#' name and reminds the agent before import silently drops it.
recommendations.root_cause: The fix addresses the documented failure mode with a conversion function but does not add a detection guard analogous to the istd-coverage check.
recommendations.fix: Optional hardening: after as_lipidomics_experiment()/read_skyline(), check for Class=NA rows whose Molecule string still contains the literal ';O' pattern, and suggest running to_lipidr_sphingoid() before re-importing.
